title: Decoding the Epigenetics and Chromatin Loop Dynamics of Androgen Receptor-Mediated Transcription
authors: Altıntaş UB; Seo J; Giambartolomei C; Ozturan D; Fortunato BJ; Nelson GM; Goldman SR; Adelman K; Hach F; Freedman ML; Lack NA
one_liner_zh: 该文通过多组学数据整合研究雄激素受体AR介导的染色质环动态与表观遗传变化，虽聚焦AR-DNA结合与基因调控，但主要依赖实验测序和网络分析，缺乏AI或物理模拟方法，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作研究，对本课题有参考价值。
abstract:
ABSTRACT

Androgen receptor (AR)-mediated transcription plays a critical role in normal prostate development and prostate cancer growth. AR drives gene expression by binding to thousands of cis-regulatory elements (CRE) that loop to hundreds of target promoters. With multiple CREs interacting with a single promoter, it remains unclear how individual AR bound CREs contribute to gene expression. To characterize the involvement of these CREs, we investigated the AR-driven epigenetic and chromosomal chromatin looping changes. We collected a kinetic multiomic dataset comprised of steady-state mRNA, chromatin accessibility, transcription factor binding, histone modifications, chromatin looping, and nascent RNA. Using an integrated regulatory network, we found that AR binding induces sequential changes in the epigenetic features at CREs, independent of gene expression. Further, we showed that binding of AR does not result in a substantial rewiring of chromatin loops, but instead increases the contact frequency of pre-existing loops to target promoters. Our results show that gene expression strongly correlates to the changes in contact frequency. We then proposed and experimentally validated an unbalanced multi-enhancer model where the impact on gene expression of AR-bound enhancers is heterogeneous, and is proportional to their contact frequency with target gene promoters. Overall, these findings provide new insight into AR-mediated gene expression upon acute androgen simulation and develop a mechanistic framework to investigate nuclear receptor mediated perturbations.
abstract_zh:
摘要

雄激素受体（AR）介导的转录在前列腺正常发育和前列腺癌生长中发挥关键作用。AR通过结合数千个顺式调控元件（CRE）驱动基因表达，这些元件与数百个靶基因启动子形成环状结构。当多个CRE与单个启动子相互作用时，单个AR结合CRE如何促进基因表达仍不清楚。为表征这些CRE的参与情况，我们研究了AR驱动的表观遗传和染色体染色质环化变化。我们收集了一个动力学多组学数据集，包括稳态mRNA、染色质可及性、转录因子结合、组蛋白修饰、染色质环化和新生RNA。利用整合调控网络，我们发现AR结合诱导CRE处表观遗传特征的顺序变化，且独立于基因表达。进一步，我们表明AR结合并不导致染色质环的显著重连，而是增加预先存在的环与靶启动子的接触频率。我们的结果显示，基因表达与接触频率的变化密切相关。随后，我们提出并实验验证了一个不平衡多增强子模型，其中AR结合增强子对基因表达的影响是异质的，且与其与靶基因启动子的接触频率成正比。总体而言，这些发现为急性雄激素刺激下AR介导的基因表达提供了新见解，并开发了一个研究核受体介导扰动的机制框架。
